notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You have a way to give Saber Ants indestructible.
description:
Give Saber Ants indestructible, if needed.
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Halana triggers, causing you to pay {2} to have that creature deal damage equal to its power to Saber Ants.
Saber Ants triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Halana triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Halana trigger, causing you to pay {2} to deal 1 damage to Saber Ants.
Repeat from step 4.
